section.description:
As the **section** parameter is optional in the request, the response will explicitly specify 
the **section** that relates to the prices returned.

listingType.description:
As the **listingType** parameter is optional in the request, the response will explicitly specify
the **listingType** that relates to the prices returned.

reupgrade.description:
As the **reupgrade** parameter is optional in the request, the response will explicitly specify 
whether the prices returned are for a subsequent upgrade (true), or if it is for the initial 
upgrade of the product (false).

date.description:
This is the date that the product prices are for. If the request did not include a date, the
date returned will be today's date (Australian Eastern Daylight Savings Time).

all.description:
These products will be automatically purchased on the customer's behalf when 
they list on realestate.com.au

elect.description:
These products are *not* automatically purchased, but customers can choose to
purchase them at their discretion. However, they have a minimum number that have 
been commited to over a specified period of time

manual.description:
These products can be manually purchased by the customer and are not 
automatically purchased on their behalf.

exceptionDowngrade.description:
In a situation where a Premiere, Highlight or Feature product will be automatically 
purchased on the customer's behalf, occassionally the customer might want to
use a different product. In this situation, the customer can choose to use their 
points to downgrade to a different product, so the points required and price charged
 will be indicate here.

payOnSale.description:
In this instance, a customer can choose to delay payment for a product until it
is sold. This is the price and points required to access these products.

flex.description:
These products are available to customers to manually purchase, so long as
they have the necessary points to access them. There is a **points** attribute 
included for each product that indicates how many points will be needed to 
access them.

cap.description:
This indicates that how many listings can have this product for the corresponding period.

For example, if the value is 5, listing more than this number for the corresponding **period** will incur the **charge** specified.

period.description:
This indicates that the length of time that the cap applies for.

For example, if the value is monthly, cap is 5 and product is standard, then customer can purchase 5 standard listings each month.

cappedProduct.description:
For a given period, this indicates the maximum amount a customer can list for a particular product before additional charges apply.
Once this number is exceeded, each additional listing with this product will be charged during the specified period.

bundle.description: These are the combined prices of pre-defined groups of products that are automatically purchased on the customer's behalf. A bundle is only returned when every product it is made up of is available in the **all** collection.

_links.description:
As part of the HAL+JSON specification, the [_links](https://tools.ietf.org/id/draft-kelly-json-hal-01.html#rfc.section.4.1)
attribute will contain a **self Link object** that is the canonical representation of this resource.

displayPrice.description: The combined price of every product in the bundle, formatted for display.

price.description: The sum of the **price** of every product in the bundle.

rackPrice.description: The sum of the **rackPrice** of every product in the bundle.

currency.description: The units of price and rackPrice.

products.description: The individual products that make up the bundle, in the order they are configured.

product_price.description: This is the price customer need to pay if they purchase the product beyond cap.

product.description:
This is the name of the product available for purchase. This product may appear multiple
times, but the combination of the product and duration should be unique (note: duration is optional).

productName.description:
This is the user friendly product name to display to the customer. This name will remain consistent
with the latest names used for each of REA's products and services and is recommended for use when
showing the customers the price of a product.

duration.description:
This is the number of active days for the specified product. This field is optional, and if it 
is not specified, it means this product is available for an unlimited time for this price.

billingCyclePeriod.description: This is the days of the billing cycle period. This field is optional, and only existing when this is a multiple billing cycle product.

displayPrice.description:
This is a formatted string that represents the price to display to the customer. This includes the
'$' symbol along with the dollar and cents amount for this product. It is important to note that there
could be other text in this field and it is recommended that this field be used to display the
price to the customer. Some potential examples of this field are '$5.00', '$1,000.00' or 
'$0 upfront, $200 when sold'

price.description:
This is the price the customer will pay for this product. It includes GST and any discounts
applicable for this customer. This value will include the dollars and cents amount, but will 
not include the '$' symbol, eg. '5.00' or '10000.00'

rackPrice.description:
This is the standard price for this product, and should be displayed to the customer to
help illustrate the discounting they receive.

currency.description: This is the units of price and rackPrice.

points.description:
Some products require the customer to use their points to be able to access a particular
product and price combination. This indicates how many points the customer has to use to
be able to access this product.

upliftedFrom.description:
This indicates that this is an uplifted product from a lower-priced depth tier. 

For example, the current product may be 'premiere' but this field will indicate that it was uplifted from a 'highlight' product.
The price field will reflect the price of the corresponding 'highlight' product.

topUpPrice.description: The extra price for Luxe in addition to original Premiere+ price. This is only applicable to Luxe prices.

self.description:
This is a HAL+JSON [Link object](https://tools.ietf.org/id/draft-kelly-json-hal-01.html#rfc.section.5)
with an **href** attribute describing the URL to this resource.
